cards.title: Play School Returns: Quality TV for Toddlers
cards.body: This beloved children's program offers a refreshing alternative to overstimulating modern shows designed to grab attention like smartphones do. Parents can feel good about letting their toddlers watch this gentle, educational content.

cards.title: Sleepover Safety: The Secret Codeword Strategy
cards.body: Teaching children a discreet codeword allows them to signal distress during sleepovers without embarrassment. This simple safety tool gives kids agency while keeping parents informed.

cards.title: Working Parents: Balancing Act and School Holidays
cards.body: The school day ending at 3pm creates logistical nightmares for working parents juggling childcare and work schedules. Better coordination of school holidays with work life could transform this stressful reality.

cards.title: Harsh Words Hurt Children's Self-Esteem Long-Term
cards.body: Careless comments from parents may be quickly forgotten by adults but can profoundly damage children's confidence for years. Parents should recognize the lasting impact of their words on developing self-worth.

cards.title: Parentification and Eating Disorders Connection
cards.body: When children take on adult roles prematurely, it can trigger long-term mental health issues including eating disorders. Early role reversal has significant consequences for child development.

cards.title: Stepparenting: Building Bonds Through Actions
cards.body: Stepchildren who notice concrete improvements in family life often become more open to bonding with their stepparent. Demonstrating positive change through actions can overcome initial resistance to blended families.

cards.title: Back to School: Reclaiming Parental Identity
cards.body: Fall routines offer parents an opportunity to rediscover their own identity, career goals, and personal recovery. Using structured school schedules to prioritize self-care benefits the whole family.

cards.title: Spotting Abusers' Custody Battle Tactics
cards.body: Domestic abusers often follow predictable legal playbooks to discredit other parents in custody disputes. Recognizing these harmful patterns helps protect children and support vulnerable parents.

cards.title: Parenting Information Overload: Finding Balance
cards.body: Parents today face overwhelming amounts of parenting advice from countless sources, creating anxiety and uncertainty. Learning to filter information and trust instincts is essential for mental wellbeing.

cards.title: Childcare Support: Addressing the £100k Cliff Edge
cards.body: Current childcare policies create a financial penalty for working parents earning above certain thresholds. Policy reform aims to make quality childcare more accessible and fair for all families.
